svg.title: Nipper Cliffs — Three reef courts with rescue cradles and rigging
svg.desc: Three wide cliff courts create distinct patrol pockets. Rescue ladders and survey scaffolds avoid narrow pinning points; the anchor tent sits outside the upper patrol.
svg.text: Three reef courts with rescue cradles and rigging
Three wide cliff courts create distinct patrol pockets. Rescue ladders and survey scaffolds avoid narrow
pinning points; the anchor tent sits outside the upper patrol.
Shell · kelp rope · sea glass · driftwood · verdigris bronze
Coral Nipper · Hostile / Common; optional local encounter.
